summary: Valentine-themed app; add an animated transition when the user clicks Yes on the "Will you be my valentine?" page.

existing_features.title: Keep the app behavior and UI the same, except: when the user clicks the existing “Yes! 💕” button on the final slide (“Will You Be My Valentine?”), play a full-screen transition animation featuring floating love emojis and maroon/pink/blue love balloons flying across the screen.

Implement the transition animation using project styling conventions (Tailwind + existing CSS animation approach) by adding any required new keyframes/utility classes and rendering a React overlay within the existing App component flow.

new_feature_requests.summary: On "Will you be my valentine?" page, when Yes is clicked, show a screen transition animation with love emojis and maroon/pink/blue love balloons flying.

projectName: Add love emoji + balloon screen transition on Yes click
